svg.title: The QR is a check. The target is local.
svg.desc: Workflow: binding stores dom and path, login matches accounts by registrable domain, a six digit code is posted to the pinned endpoint.

svg.text: Binding pins dom and path. Every later sign-in posts to that endpoint. The url in a login QR only selects an account; it is never the submit target.
